title: scan island: recorded worlds — the recorder, pr-handoff and pr-board, the island's fake gh
body:
Child 1 of Goal #3490. `islands/scan/` can now record a GitHub world whole and serve it strictly. It adds the recorder, the two recorded worlds `pr-handoff` and `pr-board`, and the island's own fake `gh`. No component changes and no requirement row changes.

**One gap is declared, not hidden (acceptance 2, `latestReviews`).** When I recorded, no open PR of teststuffstash/homelab had an element in `latestReviews`. The open PRs were #3147, #3056 and #2798, all un-reviewed, plus this PR. On this PR I added the `enhancement` label and a COMMENT review so that the snapshot holds a recorded label and a recorded review. GitHub leaves the author's own reviews and comment-only reviews out of `latestReviews` (the GraphQL `latestReviews.totalCount` on #3557 was 0). The check sits in its own test, `test_pr_board_snapshot_holds_a_latest_review_element`, marked `xfail(strict=True)`. The fix is to re-record while an open PR carries a bot verdict, for example this PR after its first review: `uv run --frozen python scripts/record_world.py pr-board 3557 3147 --rest-description c9c95fe34ced05fe076001f5c55704742bc8e7f8`. Then drop the mark. Because the mark is strict, the suite reds until it is removed.

## What is here

- `islands/scan/scripts/record_world.py`, the recorder. `record_world.py <world> <pr>…`:
  - It reads the repo's visibility first and refuses a private repo.
  - It performs the world's reads with the components' own argv (the same `--json` field lists and REST paths). Each read's stdout goes to one file, byte for byte.
  - It writes `provenance.yaml`: repo, visibility, items, each read's argv and file, `recorded_at`, `recorder_commit` (stamped `-dirty` if the recorder has uncommitted changes), and the REST description's repo, commit and file.
  - It declares the world's writes and extracts each one's response schemas from github/rest-api-description into `schemas/`. That is `descriptions-next/…/api.github.com.2022-11-28.json` at `c9c95fe3`, the version gh talks when it names none.
  - If a read answers 403, it records that read unauthenticated and marks it `auth: none`.
- `specs/worlds/pr-handoff/` records #3344, the garage v2.5.0 major. It has the bot's APPROVED at head with the four headings, two later merge commits, and the labels `dependencies`, `major` and `major/awaiting-human`. Reads: the PR view, the issue labels, the REST pull. Writes: `add-labels` 200, `remove-label` 200/404, `pr-merge-auto` (exit 0), and `get-pull-after-arm` 200, which the fake serves for the pull read once `pr merge --auto` has succeeded.
- `specs/worlds/pr-board/` holds the open-PR snapshot (4 PRs) and the per-PR reads for #3557 and #3147: commit probe, commit-and-review probe, check-runs, status, and the PR body read. Writes: `update-branch` 202/422, `create-label` 201/422, `add-labels` 200, `remove-label` 200/404, `update-pull` 200.
- `tests/fake_gh.py` is the fake `gh`. `tests/world.py` is the helper: it puts the fake first on `PATH`, applies overrides and faults to a temp copy of the world, reads the call log, and raises `UnrecordedCall`.
- Tests, all unlabelled: `tests/test_fake_gh.py`, `tests/test_world_record.py`, `tests/test_world_writes.py`.
- Spec prose: `specs/worlds/README.md` narrows its opening sentence and gains the §Recorded worlds section with its table. `specs/README.md` §Rules changes three bullets: Worlds, Rows ⇄ fixtures, and Rule 5. No requirement row, index row or Status cell changed.
- `jsonschema` 4.26.0 is a dev dependency under the existing `exclude-newer = 2026-10-08` floor. I chose it over PyYAML, which has no cp315 wheel and is sdist-only, so lock-intake-lint's install-script rule would have red it. `provenance.yaml` is therefore block YAML whose every value is a JSON scalar or flow list, read by a small strict parser in `tests/world.py`. Ruff now also covers `scripts/`.

## Acceptance

1. **Recorder.** Met.
   - `test_recorder_refuses_a_private_repo_before_any_other_read` feeds a hand-written `{"private": true}` answer. The recorder exits non-zero with "is private". The call log holds only the visibility read, and no out dir is created.
   - The control, `test_recorder_goes_past_the_visibility_read_for_a_public_repo`, passes `private: false` and the recorder goes on to its next read.
   - `test_no_world_file_holds_a_token_or_an_authorization_header` scans every file under `specs/worlds/` for `gh[opsur]_…`, `github_pat_…` and Authorization headers. Its planted-credential controls (5 cases) prove the scan can fail.
2. **Worlds.** Met except `latestReviews` (see the gap above).
   - Both worlds were recorded by the script in this ride.
   - `test_provenance_names_every_answer_file`: every file is listed, every answer parses, and `schemas/` and `writes/` match the declared writes.
   - `test_every_list_a_first_leg_row_varies_holds_a_recorded_element`: labels, reviews and commits (handoff view), the issue labels, labels and reviews (board snapshot), commits, reviews and check runs (board per-PR) all hold recorded elements. `pr-board` has 4 PRs.
3. **Write answers.** Met.
   - `test_hand_written_answer_validates_against_the_rest_description`: 12 answers each validate against their extracted schema (Draft 2020-12, and `check_schema` passes too).
   - `test_a_required_field_removed_fails_the_validation`: with a required field removed, the answer fails validation. That holds for 9 of them. The other 3 are skipped with a stated reason: GitHub's `basic-error` (the two 404s) and the `update-branch` 202 schema have no required field, so any object validates.
   - `pr-merge-auto` is an exit status (`test_the_one_gh_command_write_is_an_exit_status`).
4. **Fake gh.** Met, each behaviour with an unlabelled test.
   - Recorded read gives the file's bytes: `test_recorded_read_answers_the_file_bytes` covers every read of both worlds, and `--jq` is applied as gh applies it.
   - Unrecorded read: exit 2, the read is named, and the case fails (`test_unrecorded_read_fails_the_case`, plus undeclared writes).
   - Overrides: `test_override_changes_an_existing_value_and_copies_a_list_element`. `test_override_refuses_a_missing_or_removed_field` covers 7 refusals.
   - Faults: failing read (only the named occurrence), non-JSON body, one named field absent, write answering a hand-written 422 or 404 (`test_fault_*`).
   - Call log: every test asserts on `run.calls`.
5. **Diff and suite.** Met.
   - `git diff origin/goal/3490-scan-island-worlds -- islands/scan/src/ agents/ .github/` is empty (0 lines).
   - The first leg's 127 tests are unchanged and pass.
   - `cd islands/scan && devbox run ci` exited 0 at `3ea0cd4c`: `182 passed, 3 skipped, 1 xfailed`.
   - `git status --porcelain` printed 0 lines after the suite.
   - Every changed path is inside the issue's Touches list. Also run: `devbox run lock-intake-lint -- origin/goal/3490-scan-island-worlds` gave 4 net-new versions and 0 failures; `devbox run docs-graph-lint` gave rc 0.
6. **Spec edits.** Met, prose only, as listed above.

## Unverified items: what I found

- **Argv of each read.** Verified by running the components over the worlds: `test_pr_handoff_serves_the_major_handoff_gate_and_arm_paths` and `test_pr_board_serves_the_updater_pick_and_unstrand_reads`.
  - `major_handoff`: the gate path issues view, POST, DELETE, then the labels re-read. The arm path issues view, `pr merge --auto`, DELETE, then the after-arm pull read. Both exit 0.
  - `updater`: snapshot, Renovate commit probe, check-runs, status, `update-branch`, then the leg-2 commits+reviews probe.
  - Neither made an unrecorded call. The `--jq` filters (`.[].name`, the auto-merge one) run in the fake over the whole recorded answer.
- **Check-runs with the ride's token.** The token can read them on the public repo (200, `total_count` 4 on #3556's head). Every read is `auth: token`, and the unauthenticated fallback was not needed.
- **`pr list` / `pr view --json`.** No published schema exists for these. The recording is their shape, and only REST answers are validated.
- **The description's 3.1 rendering is unsatisfiable for nullable refs.** It renders `archived_by` as `{"allOf":[simple-user], "type":["null"]}`, which no value satisfies, and the field is required. The recorded #3344 pull failed validation against it on every label's `archived_by: null`. The extractor makes exactly one correction, named `NULLABLE_REF` in `record_world.py`: such a node reads as `anyOf [<ref>, null]`, which is what the description's own prose says. Each touched schema counts it in its `$comment`. With that correction, the recorded REST pull answer validates with 0 errors.
- **Specs-review scope.** No owner was asked for while building. If the review asks for an owner on an untouched `🚧 WIP` row, the answer is `→ #3448` in that index cell and nothing else.
- **PR #3147's recorder pilot.** I read only the file list, and nothing was copied.

Closes #3491
